# Welcome {-}

This guide from the [African Foundational Learning Data Hub](https://www.datafirst.uct.ac.za/aflearn) at DataFirst supports analysis of the [ICAN-ICAR 2025](https://palnetwork.org/ican-icar/) household survey in R. Use the [guide home](index.html) to open chapters on data wrangling, survey setup, distributions, and modelling learning outcomes. Download the dataset from [DataFirst](https://doi.org/10.25828/ah42-xw77).
